```{python}
x = np.zeros(len(bb))

    x[i] = (b[i] - np.sum(A[i]*x))/A[i,i]

print(x)
```

```{python}
# Resolvendo outro sistema
AA = np.array([[7,1,0],[0,15,-1],[0,0,10]])
bb = np.array([4,2,5])

x = np.zeros(len(bb))

for i in range(len(x)-1,-1,-1):
    print(i)
    x[i] = (bb[i] - np.sum(AA[i]*x))/AA[i,i]

print(x)
```

# Método da Eliminação de Gauss

```{python}
A = np.array([[3.,2.,4.],[1.,1.,2.],[4.,3.,-2.]])
b = np.array([1.,2.,3.])
```

```{python}
A
```

```{python}
b
```

```{python}
# Primeiro passo
b[1] = b[1] - b[0]*A[1, 0]/A[0, 0]
b[2] = b[2] - b[0]*A[2, 0]/A[0, 0]

A[1] = A[1] - A[0]*A[1, 0]/A[0, 0] 
A[2] = A[2] - A[0]*A[2, 0]/A[0, 0]
```

```{python}
# fim do primeiro passo
A
```

```{python}
b
```

```{python}
# Segundo passo
b[2] = b[2] - b[1]*A[2, 1]/A[1, 1]

A[2] = A[2] - A[1]*A[2, 1]/A[1, 1]
```

```{python}
# Agora temos uma matriz triangulo superior
A
```

```{python}
b
```

### Como fazer isso de forma eficiente?

```{python}
A = np.array([[3.,2.,4.],[1.,1.,2.],[4.,3.,-2.]])
b = np.array([1.,2.,3.])
```

```{python}
for i in range(0, len(b) - 1): 
    for ii in range(i+1, len(b)): 
        b[ii] = b[ii] - b[i]*A[ii, i]/A[i, i]
        A[ii] = A[ii] - A[i]*A[ii, i]/A[i, i] 

print(A)
```

#### Como fazer com o scipy?

```{python}
solve(A,b)
```

```{python}
A_original = np.array([[3.,2.,4.],[1.,1.,2.],[4.,3.,-2.]])
b_original = np.array([1.,2.,3.])

solve(A_original, b_original)
```
